title: Customizations
description: Sleeve customizations, keyed by asset class. Entries live under an asset-class bucket: fixed-income constraints under `fixed_income`. A bare map of entries at the top level (no asset-class bucket) is a legacy shape that is still accepted but is normalized into `fixed_income` on write; new integrations should send the container shape.

fixed_income.description: Fixed-income constraints, keyed by a caller-supplied entry id (e.g. "allocation_20260609"). Each entry is a universe filter or an allocation target.
